ordinary_coach_decision.words: Board your paid coach and physically reach Pittsburgh.
ordinary_coach_decision.intention: To move a couch and spend time with Alma.
ordinary_coach_decision.detail: The coach is marked CREW RETURN FARES and is in the lobby.

source_context.producer_following_effect: Rita spends the evening off duty.

decision.words: Take two minutes to collect Alma’s addressed envelope. Board this same coach in the second group.
decision.intention: Collect the envelope and board the coach for the second group.
decision.detail: The envelope will be delivered at the return-post window at the terminal.

decision.words: Walk past the post window, keep the envelope unfiled and take your current place at the payphone.
decision.intention: Keep your payphone and envelope as planned for the next meeting.
decision.detail: You will be leaving the queue for two minutes before the next booth is available in four minutes.

events: Phil collects the addressed envelope and boards in the second group.
Phil takes his payphone place with the unfiled envelope. There will be no signed delivery tomorrow.
